notes: v1.14.543 — LEGACY-RETIRE STAGE 3.4: THE DEAD MODE TOGGLE. The #mode-toggle strip (Command · Work · Crash Cart) and its comment are deleted, and the body.rd hide rule it shared now names only .tab-nav. 12 lines, 826 bytes. It carried an inline display:none AND a body.rd hide, and had ZERO JavaScript references — nothing in the file could ever have shown it. Its three children (#mode-command, #mode-work, #mode-ref) had zero references too; the .subtab-strip/.stab classes it borrowed are shared by 40 other places and are untouched. Dead in BOTH houses, so this ship has no visible surface anywhere. ⛔ THE OTHER TWO PLANNED TARGETS ARE NOT SHIPPED, and that is the substance of this ship. .search-wrap is STRUCK: :10064 hides it under body.rd and :10065 restores it with body.rd.mode-ref .search-wrap{display:flex} — it is the redesign's search bar on Tools, and deleting it would have removed live redesign function. #phantom-tab-pill is HELD for an owner ruling: it is the Clone War multi-tab chip whose tap says 'close it to avoid data loss', and it is the ONLY in-app multi-tab warning in the app — showBanner() renders exclusively into #boot .boot-items and returns early once boot is dismissed. ⚠ Which surfaces a gap that outlives this campaign: the pill is display:none under body.rd, so the REDESIGN has had no in-app multi-tab warning at all. Deleting the pill would remove the last one anywhere. ⭐ Three of the recon's ten Stage 3 targets have now proven wrong — #hdr-overflow-wrap, .search-wrap, #phantom-tab-pill — each wrong differently. A display:none under body.rd is the start of an investigation, never the end of one.
